topic: Whitebeard's Haki Worked While He Slept
title: Whitebeard's Haki Worked While He Slept
description: Whitebeard used Observation Haki in his sleep in chapter 552. Here is why that detail matters, and what Chinjao and Luffy add. Which side are you on?
comment: Is Haki a reflex of the body, or does the person still choose even when asleep? Pick one.

lines.text: Whitebeard's Haki kept working while he was fast asleep.

shot.fallback: anime style scene of Whitebeard with glowing aura, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Chapter 552. Ace sneaks in to attack him while the old man naps.

shot.fallback: anime style scene of Whitebeard with glowing aura, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Whitebeard never wakes up, yet Observation Haki lets him defend himself anyway.

shot.fallback: anime style scene of Whitebeard with glowing aura, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Chapter 719 does it again with Chinjao, who faints and still wears Armament Haki on his head.

shot.fallback: anime style scene of Chinjao with glowing aura, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Chapter 924, Luffy is knocked out cold by Kaido, and Supreme King Haki bursts out of him anyway.

shot.fallback: anime style scene of Luffy with glowing aura, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: The strongest argument against me is that it's only a reflex, like a sneeze.

shot.fallback: anime style scene of Whitebeard with glowing aura, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: But a reflex doesn't pick a target. Haki picked Ace, and it picked Kaido's men.

shot.fallback: anime style scene of Whitebeard with glowing aura, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: So someone was still choosing, with nobody awake to do the choosing.

shot.fallback: anime style scene of Luffy with glowing aura, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Haki isn't something the body performs. It's something the person keeps holding.

shot.fallback: anime style scene of Whitebeard with glowing aura, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: So what was Whitebeard holding that never switched off, even in his sleep?

shot.fallback: anime style scene of Whitebeard with glowing aura, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Which is why, in chapter 552, Whitebeard's Haki kept working while he was fast asleep.

shot.fallback: anime style scene of Whitebeard with glowing aura, dramatic lighting, no text
